extracted.intended_audience: clients/PR professionals preparing a Multichannel News Release (PR Newswire/MultiVu)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and production requirements for creating and submitting a PR Newswire Multichannel News Release (MNR) — a multimedia HTML5 press release page. Covers assets, branding, media specs, text instructions, translations, and reporting expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission readiness and commencement
rubrics_metrics.description: Your Multichannel News Release order can commence as soon as three of the components and assets listed below have been submitted to the Multichannel News Release team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Core working hours are 08:00 to 17:30 GMT, Monday to Friday. Upon receipt of a client's order PR Newswire will be in touch with turn-around times. Use file sharing services (WeTransfer, Dropbox etc.) when sending assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of file sharing services for assets
rubrics_metrics.description: When sending us your Multichannel News Release assets, please use one of the following file sharing services, WeTransfer, Dropbox etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps ensure reliable transfer of large multimedia assets; mention your contact details for queries ([email protected], +44(0)207 454 5111).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition and scope of Multichannel News Release (MNR)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Multichannel News Release (MNR) is a dynamic HTML5 page with the ability to encompass text, images, video, audio, documents, live Twitter & Facebook feeds and much more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MNRs make distribution and sharing of multimedia content simple. Use the MNR page to host richer multimedia assets while the text release is distributed to standard distribution points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Branding and layout requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Fully branded Multichannel News Releases need help from you, the client. Any branding ideas, guidelines, colours or images supplied upfront are a big help in getting your Multichannel News Release started.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide branding guidelines, colours, and images early to facilitate a fully branded MNR. Examples and previous MNRs are available for inspiration (links provided on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design option selection
rubrics_metrics.description: We have five design options available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose among the provided design templates (HERO, SHOWCASE, HERO SIDE BAR, HERO INLINE, HERO LITE) — previous examples are shown to help you select the best layout for your content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video length and language recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure your video is less than 5 minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This focuses your video's message, cuts down on page-load times, and is much easier for the viewer to digest. That your video is in English is recommended—PR Newswire can offer distribution in multiple languages (English subtitles recommended); however, most of our portals are global. English language videos will maximise pick-up. PR Newswire provides Online Video Distribution (OVD) to over 15 leading online video portals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image metadata and engagement requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Images can be located in various locations on the MNR page based on your chosen MNR design, all Images should have a title, caption and file name to allow for optimum engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Titles: 100 Characters including spaces. Captions - 250 Characters including spaces. Supply photo captions with each image to maximise engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image technical specifications and acceptable formats
rubrics_metrics.description: We recommend your photos to be 2700 pixels on the longest side and 300 dpi.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptable file formats: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, GIF. Follow recommended pixel dimensions and dpi to ensure image quality on the MNR page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release text content and distribution behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: This text portion of your Multichannel News Release will be the same that goes out to all of your desired distribution points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After the first paragraph of your release there will be a link to your Multichannel News Release page, which users can click through to the Multichannel News Release. The idea, the sale, the product or your message should be accurately and concisely conveyed. PR Newswire's editorial service can provide proofreading and editorial suggestions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations, language toggles, and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire's distribution service is a truly global platform. Translations can take up to 48 hours to complete.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clients are encouraged to supply their own translations where possible. Language toggles can be added to any MNR to switch and view text in different languages; toggles are offered in 23 languages (list provided). Additional charges apply for translation/toggle services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive reporting expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: The reporting for your campaign is available 24/7 within our online reporting platform - Visibility Reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: With Visibility Reports expect: Robust Data (full distribution and specific page interactions), Visuals (dynamic graphics with mouse-over charts), Export and Sharing Features (download graphs in various formats), and Easy Access (view from alert emails or log in anytime).

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead generation form availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Lead Generation Form (heading present on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the page references a lead generation form, no detailed requirements/specs are provided here — expect an option to capture leads via the MNR where configured.
